title: temporal phase clocks and a parallel merge loop

commit.merge_subject: merge: temporal phase clocks and a parallel merge loop

description: Export CPU bottleneck. The full-resolution merge loop of temporalMergeCfa was about 90% of the temporal stage (104-175 ms per frame on the heavy 4K clip) and ran on one thread. Its rows are independent, so they now go through core's parallelForRows (bit-exact contract: one thread per row range, immutable inputs). The only cross-row state, two diagnostic weight sums and the pixel count, is kept per row and combined in row order, so serial and parallel runs report identical numbers. A new desktop test pins the output of two full merge scenarios (both neighbors eligible, real shifts, noise and a noise profile) as FNV-1a checksums taken from the OLD serial code, and requires the forced-serial and the parallel runs to equal them: the output is bit-identical to before.
